skill: trailofbits/skills plugins/audit-context-building (pinned); run as a subagent writing one record per function to review/context/functions/ (network__api__*, core__actions__push__*; 86 records)
run: 2026-10-11; the dossier names no vulnerabilities by design; its `nothing found` assumptions about what the host can say and the client believes are turned into claims below
the_rule_as_implemented: every host response is accepted raw at the point of receipt; verification is the caller's and exists only for bare/data (content address, Vault__Verified_Write); mutable files are decrypt-only; host TEXT (listings, per-file status words, batch replies, presigned dicts, error bodies) is trusted as control

findings.title: a host that answers an empty listing for bare/ makes the client treat the push as a first push and plain-write every file under its local bare/ (refs, indexes, keys, legacy private keys) with no compare-and-swap: a stale clone, told 'empty', rewrites the shared branch head to its own older value
findings.status: VULN (reproduced with an empty-listing host; fixed: TM-F34)
evidence: _is_first_push L717-725 (list_files('bare/') empty → True; no cross-check with the ref read at L86); _server_has_named_ref L765-772 (substring over the listing); _upload_bare_to_server L774-818 plain-writes every regular file
Batch.build_push_operations L101-104: ref op is a plain write when expected_ref_hash is None
actor: A1 alone (a listing is not encrypted or signed)

proposed.fix: 'first push' requires both an empty listing AND the server's not_found on the named ref AND an empty branch index read; a listing that omits a ref the clone has already accepted (its baseline) is a host inconsistency and refuses
proposed.test: Fixed: in-memory host answers [] to list_files while holding the ref → push refuses

findings.title: the server's per-file not_found on the named ref drops the compare-and-swap for that push (expected_ref_hash=None → plain write): the host can convert a guarded push into an unguarded one
evidence: TM-R33 covers the honest case (no create-if-absent); the dishonest host case is this one; TM-F21 made 'only the server's not-found is absent', which is exactly the word the host chooses

proposed.fix: when the clone holds a baseline for the branch, a not_found from the host is a rewind-shaped answer: refuse unless --accept-rewind

findings.title: _checked treats an empty reply ({}), missing results or a short results list as success; Index_Sync.require_written the same; _request turns any empty 2xx body into {}
findings.status: VULN (reproduced with an empty-reply host: push reported pushed, objects_uploaded 1, nothing written; fixed on the batch path and the individual-write fallback: TM-F33)
evidence: _checked L301-319; Vault__API._request L394-399; Index_Sync.require_written L250-255 (per the dossier)
TM-F21 required 'ok' for writes; the dossier reads the current code as still accepting an absent results list

proposed.fix: a batch reply must carry one result per op with ok=true; anything else is a failed push
proposed.test: in-memory host answers {} → push reports failure

findings.title: error-message substrings that embed the host's response body drive control decisions: a 404/405/501 text on the batch route flips a writable session to the static read-only transport permanently; other substrings classify 'not found' and 'no write access'
evidence: _api_error L470-510 embeds the body; Auto._resolve_from_error L47-61 and _call L63-79; _batch_read_chunk_with_fallback L173/L183; _classify_exception L282-283; Index_Sync.upload L190
a host body containing 'HTTP 404' turns the session read-only (DoS of writes for that process) and sends the token nowhere (static passes access_token=None)

proposed.fix: classify on the status code the client observed, never on body text; keep the body for the user's error message only

findings.title: no response-size cap anywhere on the receive side (fetch_presigned, _send, Static._fetch): a host serves a multi-gigabyte body for a 4 KB object and the client reads it into memory before the content-address check
findings.status: VERIFY (DoS class; the register accepts DoS from the host, TM-R18 style, but this one is memory, not CPU)

proposed.fix: read at most the size the object record claims plus a margin; refuse beyond it

findings.title: the multipart PUT to a presigned URL follows redirects unchecked and does not honour tls_verify; part_size and part_number from the host are trusted
findings.status: VERIFY (low: check_presigned_url runs before the PUT, so the first hop is https; a redirect hop is not re-checked, unlike fetch_presigned which re-checks hops)
evidence: _upload_large L109-170: check_presigned_url L140, then urlopen(req) L143 with urllib's default redirect handling; fetch_presigned L37-56 re-checks each hop

proposed.fix: an opener that refuses redirects for the PUT (or re-checks each hop as fetch_presigned does)

findings.title: _push_branch_only uploads a chain and CAS-moves the clone ref with no pull and no signature check
findings.status: VERIFY (by design for the clone's own private branch? the policy applies to the named branch on pull; the dossier asks)

findings.title: _register_pending_branch: a transient read error of the remote index (read_remote → (None, None)) leads to a plain index write without CAS; the public key file is assumed public
evidence: L820-885; Index_Sync.read_remote returns (None, None) on transient error per the dossier

findings.title: tls_verify=False disables verification for the whole pool including an https proxy, and for fetch_presigned and the static transport
evidence: ssl_context L148-151 built once per pool; open_via_proxy L176-190 uses it

findings.title: the Vault__Backend trio has no production caller, and its base batch executes write-if-match as a plain write (CAS dropped) and drops 'read' ops
findings.status: CLEARED (dead code; redundant_code for the records; a future caller would lose CAS silently)
evidence: Vault__Backend L13-50; Backend__API; Backend__Local (no path containment on join)

proposed.fix: delete the trio or make the base batch raise NotImplemented for write-if-match

findings.title: _reconcile_cache rebuilds cache objects from bytes fetched by _make_blob_fetcher without a content-address check in this slice (whether Cache_Manager.rebuild_for_path verifies is an open question)
static transport: manifest file ids and a root-file read on the local branch are not containment-checked; _fetch follows redirects without a size cap
findings.status: VERIFY (round-2 territory: serve / mirror / publish own this transport)
evidence: list_files L202-216, read_root_file L218-225, _read_manifest L227-240, _fetch L112-138; _location L70-84 does contain the object path (A4) but not the root file path

findings.title: transient-status retries (429/502/503/504, ×4) resend non-idempotent writes and CAS ops; a CAS the server already applied then conflicts against the client's own bytes, which execute_batch's fast path reports as a teammate race
findings.status: VERIFY (low: a false 'conflict' message, not a wrong write)
evidence: _request_bytes L401-428; Batch.execute_batch L246-299 (re-raises), execute_individually/_atomic_move recover via _holds

findings.title: the in-memory host differs from the live contract in five ways (absence as RuntimeError('Not found') vs HTTP 404 vs static None; top-level conflict vs per-op; non-atomic mid-loop conflict; batch_read always answering every id; list_files prefixing bare/)
findings.status: CLEARED as a finding; recorded for the test strategy: hermetic security tests cannot see the four live-only shapes, which is why the integration job keeps the server-boundary test
